definitions.explanation: Used in questions or exclamations to ask about or emphasize degree or extent.
Used with 〜ても to express 'no matter how much ~'. Indicates that the result remains the same regardless of the degree.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't put into words how happy I was.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{頑張|がんば}っても→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, it's impossible.
examples.notes: どんなに〜ても = no matter how ~

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{忙|いそが}しくても→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Contact me no matter how busy you are.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧？
examples.english: Do you understand how hard it was?

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{待|ま}っても→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}している→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I can't express in words how grateful I am.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{説明|せつめい}しても→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦{分|わ}かってくれない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, they don't understand.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{心配|しんぱい}した→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧！
どんなに⟦{高|たか}くても→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I'll buy it no matter how expensive it is.

examples.japanese: どんなに⟦{会|あ}いたかった→会う：00482_au⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧！
examples.english: How much I wanted to see you!

notes:
GRAMMAR: どんなに has two main uses:

1. EXCLAMATORY (how ~!):
- どんなに〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (how ~ [it is]!)
- どんなに〜⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (how very ~!)
- Emphasizes degree in exclamations

2. CONDITIONAL (no matter how):
- どんなに〜ても (no matter how much ~)
- どんなに〜でも (no matter how ~)
- Result is unaffected by the degree

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いくら→いくら：00943_ikura⟧〜ても (no matter how much - often with quantity)
- ⟦たとえ→たとえ：03405_tatoe⟧〜ても (even if)
- ⟦どれだけ→どれだけ：24191_doredake⟧ (how much)
- ⟦どれほど→どれほど：22424_dorehodo⟧ (how much - formal)

RELATED QUESTION WORD:
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧ (what kind of) - どんなに is the adverbial form
